description: A round white base with a raised threaded hub sits on the wooden tabletop, and a separate white cross-shaped table piece is off to the right. The left hand stays resting near the base while the right hand reaches to the cross-shaped piece, lifts it, moves it leftward over the base, and lowers it onto the center hub, rotating slightly to align and seat it before letting go; the cross-shaped piece is a right-hand object during placement and becomes unsupported when released.
